round_history.retrieved_content:
[DAY4 21:53:00 - DAY4 21:53:30]
I turn off the faucet and shake the water off, turn around holding chopsticks, walk from the first-floor living room up to the second floor, arrange the chopsticks, and start handing them out. "Everyone, twist one," I say. Lucia: "I'll wash my hands." Lucia and Alice decline; Lucia adds, "I just came back from the hospital" and "I don't dare to touch the food directly." Tasha looks concerned. Katrina says, "Try it."

[DAY4 20:43:30 - DAY4 20:43:59]
She hasn't replied to me, so I start a WeChat video call. I click the call, turn on my earpiece, and hold my phone with the WeChat call screen. "Hey, hello, hello," I say, then ask, "Where are you?" The lighting is a bit dim. Lucia: "Ah, I'm outside, I mean I'm at... this health clinic here. Because this afternoon, the puppy... it scratched my hand a bit. My family wasn't too sure, so they wanted me to get a vaccine." "Oh," I say. "Oh, that's why," I add as I walk toward the door, open it, and walk into the yard. Lucia: "And, and also, I checked..."

[DAY4 20:44:31 - DAY4 20:45:00]
Nighttime lights reflect on my phone screen as I hold it and walk to the side of the table on a WeChat call. I ask, "So, did you get it done or are you still waiting?" and "Or are you still in line or what?" Lucia replies, "Just finished consulting the doctor, and I think it's better to get it done now." I pick up a toy from the table. "Oh, okay," I say. "Got it, got it," I say. "Alright, don't rush," I say. "Okay, let's leave it at that," I say. Lucia replies, "Alright, bye-bye." I end the WeChat call. "Okay, bye-bye," I say. I laugh. I walk toward Nicous, step into the foyer, shake the toy in my hand, and step toward the stairs.
